symbol

In 3 symbols, forms associated with birth, death and healing can be combined until their components are hard to pick out. A mark that was legible in its first drawing can take on a different force in a composite. How much of its meaning depends on being able to identify what went into it? An inherited sign, whose maker is beyond reach, can raise the same question. 3 symbols

Reading note. Alchemy and Jung. In Psychology and Alchemy, Jung follows mandala imagery across a dream series. The symbols in 3 symbols also change across versions and composites. Where does a symbol’s earlier meaning still help us read it, and what does its combination with other forms allow it to do? Psychology and Alchemy, part II
